patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Prevents the app from requesting banner, in-read and mediated ads.

patches.name: Disable article ads
patches.description: Prevents ads from being inserted into article bodies.

patches.name: Disable interstitial ads
patches.description: Prevents the app from showing full-screen interstitial ads.

patches.name: Disable video ads
patches.description: Prevents pre-roll and mid-roll ads from playing in the video player.
